            x=x + seg_len / 2,

            width=0.5,  # Thinner diagonal beam
            height=0.5,  # Thinner diagonal beam

        )
        sandbox.add_joint(top_chord[i], d1, (x, ty), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(bot_chord[i+1], d1, (x + seg_len, next_by), type='rigid')

        # Second diagonal from bottom[i] to top[i+1]
        d2_angle = math.atan2((ty - by), seg_len)
        d2 = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=x + seg_len / 2,
            y=(ty + by) / 2,
            width=0.5,  # Thinner diagonal beam
            height=0.5,  # Thinner diagonal beam
            angle=d2_angle,
            density=10.0
        )
        sandbox.add_joint(bot_chord[i], d2, (x, by), type='rigid')
        sandbox.add_joint(top_chord[i+1], d2, (x + seg_len, ty), type='rigid')

    # Return the correct tip body
